inProperty is in the given list of values. Separate list items with |'filter=fieldname in ' + encodeURIComponent('value1|value2')
likeProperty contains (at least) the given value'filter=fieldname like ' + encodeURIComponent('yes, maybe')
notlikeProperty does not contain the given value'filter=fieldname notlike ' + encodeURIComponent('yes, maybe')
